unsafe_statement_pattern: Underexpanded-jet shock topology determines the loading of HPDI pilot droplets.
why_unsafe: MP-033 has no co-located time-resolved HPDI validation.
safe_statement_boundary: Topology is a physically plausible source of gas-state variation; actual pilot-droplet loading remains unvalidated.

unsafe_statement_pattern: NPR comparison shows a universal shock or penetration trend.
why_unsafe: Numerator role, pressure type/location/time basis, ambient state, geometry, and transient stage may differ.
safe_statement_boundary: Compare only definition-complete contextual NPR under compatible boundary and state qualifiers.

why_unsafe: Mach context, We components, loading duration, d0, Oh, and liquid state jointly organize response.
safe_statement_boundary: Use definition-complete We as one component of a condition-matched multivariable response state.

unsafe_statement_pattern: Single-droplet breakup results apply to HPDI pilot sprays.
why_unsafe: MP-032 is unvalidated and collective, thermal, turbulent, polydisperse, and reacting effects can alter response.
safe_statement_boundary: Canonical results establish mechanisms and required variables; dense-spray transfer requires explicit collective-state correction and validation.

unsafe_statement_pattern: Evaporation suppresses breakup or evaporation promotes breakup.
why_unsafe: Opposite mechanisms dominate in different size, thermal, volatility, Stefan, and observation domains.
safe_statement_boundary: State the observed direction only within the matched thermal/interfacial condition domain.

unsafe_statement_pattern: Shock improves HPDI ignition through enhanced atomization.
why_unsafe: MP-028 and MP-029 are evidence gaps; component evidence does not close shock→mixture→ignition causality.
safe_statement_boundary: Shock-mediated breakup is a plausible upstream hypothesis; direct timing/mixture/ignition evidence is separate.

unsafe_statement_pattern: A specific ΔSOI or overlap universally optimizes ignition and emissions.
why_unsafe: Fuel order, sign, geometry, oxygen/T, load, and event definitions condition direction and optimum.
safe_statement_boundary: Report timing effects within matched chronology and operating conditions; compare signed events only.

unsafe_statement_pattern: RDE or detonation results prove HPDI strong-wave behavior.
why_unsafe: Reacting history, geometry, repeated waves, chemistry, and characteristic scales differ; MP-034 is analogue-only.
safe_statement_boundary: Use strong-wave studies as bounded analogues and state the missing HPDI mapping.

unsafe_statement_pattern: Equal Mach implies equal droplet loading or breakup.
why_unsafe: Incident, post-shock, local-relative, and detonation Mach differ; reacting post-wave histories can diverge.
safe_statement_boundary: Match the Mach definition and retain post-wave velocity, sound speed, pressure gradient, chemistry, and duration.

unsafe_statement_pattern: The review provides complete aerobreakup taxonomy coverage.
why_unsafe: C004/C-F-04 remains missing and cannot be reconstructed from secondary material.
safe_statement_boundary: State that broad taxonomy is supported by the available corpus but retains the explicit C004 source limitation.

unsafe_statement_pattern: A reduced breakup model predicts downstream fragment, cloud, and evaporation behavior.
why_unsafe: Validation targets and condition ranges differ; no single model covers all listed observables.
safe_statement_boundary: State exactly which response and condition range each model supports.
notes: A paper-conditioned TAB claim is not universal validation.

unsafe_statement_pattern: Mean fragment diameter determines transport and evaporation.
why_unsafe: Fragment PDFs, velocities, spacing, weighting, detection threshold, and time evolve and are sparse.
safe_statement_boundary: Use a typed, time-resolved population state where available and state diagnostic limits.
